notes: PCB reads G1.Sniper M5 (LGA1150, micro-ATX). Distinct from G1.Sniper 5 and B5 but same family and look; kept in test so family-level similarity is a known, documented limitation. Three PCIe x16-size slots and one x1 (partly under silkscreen); CPU_FAN boxed, CPU_OPT left unlabeled; SATA ports hidden in dark area and left unlabeled.
Annotation by visual inspection without model proposals. Legacy PCI, mSATA, USB, RGB and audio headers excluded.
All later images of this motherboard must retain this split.
Source file was an MPO with two frames; re-encoded to single-frame JPEG (first frame, quality 97) so the runtime accepts it. Box coordinates unchanged.
